description:
Token Quick Check: Ethereum mainnet contract facts -- name, supply, owner, code. Not financial advice.  Returns: a token verdict preview on one token contract: the contract facts the full verdict reads -- code size, name, symbol, decimals, total supply, owner(), proxy slots -- read from the chain. No grade, no model, no pool price, no holders, no safety or legitimacy call.

GET https://api.arysphere.com/v1/ventures/x402_eth_token_verdict_v1/eth_erc20_token_facts_preview. Same payment terms as that HTTP route.
Call once with no payment. The result is the payment terms. Retry the same call with the signed payment at _meta["x402/payment"].
name: x402_eth_token_verdict_v1__eth_erc20_token_facts_preview
